graham.brief:
This one won't make the highlight package, and the numbers mostly agree with the shrug. New England carries the 8th-heaviest injury load in the league. That's where I'd start.

New England sends extra rushers more than almost anybody, and Jacksonville has handled that better than most. Shared reads are comfortable, which is exactly when I check the individual numbers.

According to New England Patriots, cornerback Carlton Davis set to return. Trevor Lawrence is the starter who's played 94% of the snaps. Lawrence's line is 33.5 pass attempts, well above the 26 he's averaging. They've set Bhayshul Tuten at 12.5 rush attempts, below the 14 he's averaging.

The books are cooking from the same recipe here. Jacksonville is favored by 2.5 with a 45.5 total. Flat here, flat there. At least we're consistent. Henderson's carry line keeps climbing, which is a strange thing to price on a team the books have behind. I'd want another week of this before I called it anything. Sunday is that week.
